narrative_rule: A long explanation without durable references is not continuity; a receipt without semantic explanation is also insufficient; the successor needs inspectable evidence and understandable meaning.
purpose: The handoffs doctrine of the activation kit: the required handoff packet contents, why narrative-only handoffs fail, and the successor standard.
successor_standard: The next Naya should reconstruct state from the handoff plus canonical sources, then independently verify critical claims.
title: OPERATIONS / HANDOFFS
